title: Contents of the cave and the three body types

tellings.quote: The cave contained over 200 body parts, isolated heads, limbs, and appendages, and in many cases, entire intact bodies.

plain: A cave in the Nazca region of Peru is said to have held more than 200 body parts: lone heads, limbs and other appendages, and in many cases whole bodies still intact. Michels describes the find himself and cites a man named Leandro as a witness to it. If true, the find would point to strange bodies kept hidden in the Peruvian desert.
